infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kraków Park Explorer shows parks near you and plans routes. Location is used only while you use the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you actively follow a route, Kraków Park Explorer watches your location to detect when you reach a park. Tracking stops the moment the route ends.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: While you actively follow a route, Kraków Park Explorer watches your location to detect when you reach a park. Tracking stops the moment the route ends.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take memory photos at the parks you visit.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos from your library to park visits.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your park memory photos to your photo library.
